taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-19 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQ-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-19
Curve type: KQ-type
Aquifer depth: 0 – 25.53 m
Recommendation: Drill to a maximum depth of approximately 26 m to exploit the weathered overburden layer, as the underlying highly resistive bedrock (>4300 ohm-m) indicates poor deep groundwater potential. Install screening within the saturated sections of the upper weathered zone.
